classification_rationale: The customer is proposing a specific 22% discount on a large multi-site booking, which is a commercial price negotiation rather than something covered by standard policy.

draft.reply_body:
Hello,

Thank you for thinking of us for this project, and for the details on the scope.

We can certainly look at preferential pricing for a multi-site framework booking of that size, but a 22% reduction is beyond what any of our regional managers can approve directly - our discount authority tops out at 15% at that level, and anything higher has to go through our Managing Director.

If you can send over the full scope (sites, equipment list, expected duration), we'll put together a proposal within what we can approve here and flag your request for the additional discount to management for a decision. We'll come back to you as soon as we hear back.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service

commitments.description: Declines to commit to a 22% discount at this stage, as it exceeds the highest discretionary discount authority in the company
Offers to prepare a volume-pricing proposal within standard authority and refer the additional discount request to management for a decision

customer_questions: Is a 22% discount off list rates justified for a large multi-site framework booking, and can Haapaharju agree to it?

questions_addressed.answer_summary: Explained that 22% exceeds the highest discount authority (15%) and needs Managing Director referral; offered a proposal within standard limits plus escalation of the rest.
